reviews.review: Fun and addictive!  Would crab again.

new update ruined this fun game. 
pros of new update : the new maps are nice
negatives : movement feels like you are stuck in mud now, the loot is awful, nerfed every fun item, plus you now have to do the whole weapon selection again to obtain the new highest rank on each. 
no thanks, it was fun while it lasted I aint grinding this trash now.

Edit for dev comment: the movement does feel off, I'm not sure what it is but it feels like you are more slugish & slower to build up momentum. Maybe maps are just a bigger size so it feels slower to get around or whatever, second loot - did a whole run and only saw a single purple when I was playing to test out the new weapon ( to get the new achievements) and update. The new weapon is good but the loot RNG feels worse than before by a large margin. Also I already grinded the game for the diamond all items achievement and its not a fun process(some of the weapons are awful to use and I don't want to re-spend 40min average per to get a single achievement to keep the game 100%, just isn't good craic.), I get some might want the badge but I don't want to redo the runs to just get an achievement, I do enjoy the game having a harder gameplay loop but I don't want to regrind something that I did already. It feels like the time I put into the game was just worthless and not respected now and it just shows that the likely hood of this type of thing repeating will more than likely happen. So there isnt much point in regrinding for the new ranks as in 6 month i could be in the same spot again.
reviews.developer_response:
Movement is buffed from before, there were no nerfs at all to it.

Regarding loot I'm happy to look into any specific examples that you felt were nerfed too hard: the game went through a few months of beta where a few outliers were reined in a bit but there were far more buffs in this patch overall. This is better for the health of the game as if you have a small number of OP outliers then the game end up feeling RNG dependent to get them.

Fair enough regarding the new rank: it's an optional extra challenge for those that were bored with Diamond runs but wanted a harder medal to grind!

EDIT: replying to the response

Thanks for explaining, fair points!

Definitely possible the new map layouts make it feel slower even if it is numerically the same as before.

A whole run but only one purple? You get at least 3 purples from elite islands in a non looped run and that's not to mention spiked chests, extra elite islands, gauntlets (multiple purples and legendaries on average) and buffed rarity in shops (higher tier loot is more likely to spawn in shops compared to before). Loot RNG hasn't been changed other than that shop buff mentioned so it's possible you just had a bad streak of luck if you were looking for purely natural purple spawns

Completely fair to feel that way about the new rank. Basically I was in a position where one of the main pieces of feedback coming in was "Nightmare is too easy and I want to play Ultra Chaos but won't do it until there is a rank / achievement for it" and felt like it was the right thing to do in order to give people something to work towards.

Totally understand that you don't want to regrind but it's more of a long term mastery thing for people that want to keep playing than a mandatory grind. If it is any consolation I have no plans to add another medal ever again to the game- Prismatic is the limit 🦀
